title: [Dashboard] diskless nodes crash reporter_agent resulting in no stats
description:
What happened + What you expected to happen
When running ray on a databricks cluster, no stats appear in the dashboard.
In the dashboard_agent.log I see:


Traceback (most recent call last):40  File "/databricks/python/lib/python3.9/site-packages/ray/dashboard/modules/reporter/reporter_agent.py", line 827, in _perform_iteration41    stats = self._get_all_stats()42  File "/databricks/python/lib/python3.9/site-packages/ray/dashboard/modules/reporter/reporter_agent.py", line 491, in _get_all_stats43    disk_stats = self._get_disk_io_stats()44  File "/databricks/python/lib/python3.9/site-packages/ray/dashboard/modules/reporter/reporter_agent.py", line 401, in _get_disk_io_stats45    stats.read_bytes,46AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'read_bytes

the  def _get_disk_io_stats(): method in reporter_agent.py needs some sort of error handling for that rather than crashing the report for all the other stats

Versions / Dependencies
ray 2.1.0
python 3.9.5

Reproduction script
start ray with:


ray start --head --include-dashboard=true

on a databricks cluster and check the dashboard_agent.log
